title: This is Fine: What NetScaler Zero-Days Tell Us About the New Normal
description: In September 2026, multiple zero-day vulnerabilities affecting Citrix NetScaler ADC and Gateway were actively exploited by unidentified threat actors. These vulnerabilities allowed unauthenticated remote code execution, prompting Citrix to release emergency patches for CVE-2026-88771 through CVE-2026-88778. The rapid detection and patching reflect improved global telemetry and vendor coordination. Organizations using NetScaler devices should remain vigilant for potential additional advisories and maintain readiness to apply emergency patches promptly.
